plain: Sharpness or harshness in the way a person speaks or acts

webster.text: Roughness of surface; unevenness; opposed to smoothness.

more.text: Roughness or ruggedness of temper; moroseness; sourness; crabbedness.

example.quote: I hesitate not to submit it to the decision of any candid and honest adversary of the proposed government, whether language can furnish epithets of too much asperity, for so shameless and so prostitute an attempt to impose on the citizens of America.
